expected_issues.title: max_query_params dereferences a connection that may not be open
expected_issues.description:
max_query_params dereferences self.connection.connection, which is None until a connection has been opened, so accessing the feature before the first query raises AttributeError.

max_query_params used to be a class constant and is read by code paths (bulk operations, batching, checks) that may run before any query was executed. `self.connection.connection` is the raw DB-API connection and is None when not yet connected. The property must call self.connection.ensure_connection() first.

annotator_notes: Upstream change https://github.com/django/django/commit/358fd21c47cdf7bda520ce73c5cfd82bba57827b. Primary issue confirmed by the later upstream fix https://github.com/django/django/commit/847b2badccbd87fc3e657725eb316b092265912d; its regression test reproduces the problem on this head.
